overview: The committee debated competing drafts of an ordinance to establish wage and benefit floors for contracted city services and approved a request for a formal policy on how the council accesses legal advice.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance (Item 25189)
items.summary: The committee discussed an ordinance setting wage floors and labor standards for contracted janitorial and security services, ultimately voting to report a version including labor peace and worker retention provisions to the regular session.

items.title: Legal Advice Access Policy
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting that the administration provide a written policy detailing the procedures for the City Council and individual councilors to receive legal advice from city-contracted counsel.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents and a former city official commented on the need for a dedicated city solicitor and suggested modifications to the 90-day contractor transition period.
